Chat request with tool_choice set to required forces the model to call a tool

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const liter_llm = @import("liter_llm");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _api_key = std.c.getenv("API_KEY") orelse return error.MissingApiKey;
    var _client = try liter_llm.create_client(std.mem.span(_api_key), null, null, null, null);
    defer _client.free();
    const _result_json = try _client.chat("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is the weather today?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"tool_choice\":\"required\",\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"description\":\"Get the current weather for a given location\",\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"location\":{\"description\":\"The city name\",\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"location\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
